summary.headline: J. Kumar Infra Q1 FY27 revenue rose 2% to Rs 1,511 crore, but margins moderated and FY27 15% growth guidance (~Rs 6,500 crore) depends on H2 execution.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue rose about 2% YoY to Rs 1,511 crore in Q1 FY27 versus Rs 1,484 crore. Management attributed margin moderation to timing factors and project mix, and cited a BMC temporary ban on construction-site water use as slowing some projects. Order inflow in Q1 is about Rs 5,000 crore, with Rs 1,500 crore more L1 on the DMRC underground package, and the company targets Rs 8,000-10,000 crore of FY27 inflow. Management reiterated 15% revenue growth for FY27, with the bulk expected in H2 as new projects ramp up.

segments.name: Chennai (QB ticket) project
segments.commentary: State package of Rs 580 crore is about 20% executed; completion moved to December 2028 from the original schedule, due to Kuvam river restrictions, and management says the client paid for the delay with no margin impact.

segments.name: GMLR (Mumbai tunnel)
segments.commentary: Tunnel casting reached about 4 km; the first TBM is due to be assembled and launched shortly. Internal completion target is June 2029 against a client date of November 2028, with tree-cutting permission received only in August 2025.

segments.name: Vadhavan port road (VDCR)
segments.commentary: Mobilisation under way, but excavation starts only in October after the monsoon; revenue expected from Q3 FY27. Limited land acquisition needed, about 6-7 km of the 32 km stretch.

segments.name: Anand Nagar (Mumbai) project
segments.commentary: Government completion schedule is October-November 2028; toll and hotel decisions pending on the initial 2.5 km.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth of 15% on FY26 top line, about Rs 6,500 crore; management says growth is achievable with H2 weighted.
Q2 growth expected to be positive; Vadhavan revenue starts from Q3 FY27.
FY27 order inflow target of Rs 8,000-10,000 crore; Rs 7,000 crore secured (Rs 5,500 crore booked plus Rs 1,500 crore L1 on DMRC underground).
EBITDA margin guidance of 14-15% for upcoming projects; management aims to lift it toward 15-16% over time.
Rs 7,500 crore revenue target moved from FY27 to FY28 at 14-15% margin.
Working capital guided to stay in a 100-110 day range.
Capex of about Rs 150 crore a year in FY27-28 including maintenance; no new large capex unless a big project is won.
Depreciation to rise to about Rs 60 crore a quarter once the Rs 300 crore TBM is capitalised.
Net debt to fall as term loans are repaid; gross debt expected below Rs 800 crore by year-end.
capex_capacity: Q1 FY27 capex stated as Rs 34 crore.
Rs 300 crore TBM (GMLR) to be capitalised within days; CWIP to convert to gross block.
Capitalisation of about Rs 480 crore last year adds to FY27 depreciation.
Maintenance capex about Rs 100 crore a year; total of about Rs 150 crore a year for the next two years including maintenance, per the capex discussion.
Chennai project TBM and related capex funded through term loans, the main driver of gross debt rising to Rs 840 crore.
demand_pricing: Order book about Rs 22,000 crore as of end-June, plus about Rs 5,000 crore won in Q1 and Rs 1,500 crore L1 on DMRC underground.
Pipeline of Rs 50,000-1 lakh crore expected over 9-12 months, mainly MSRDC (Shaktipeeth), Uttan-Virar corridor (MMRDA, about Rs 50,000-60,000 crore), NHAI flyovers and DMRC metro packages.
Management says award timing may slip 3-6 months and some big projects may come only next year.
Receivables described as prompt from DMRC, MMRDA, MSRDC, BMC and NHAI; delays reported from irrigation and PWD departments, which management says it does not face.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Chennai project status and does the delay affect margins?
qa_highlights.answer: About 20% of the Rs 580 crore state package is executed; completion is now December 2028 because of Kuvam river restrictions. The client has paid for the delay and there is no margin impact.

qa_highlights.question: What is the GMLR timeline, and is the 2-year extension in play?
qa_highlights.answer: The client date is November 2028 and internal target is June 2029. Management says it is entitled to a 2-year extension but does not plan to use it. The TBM is ready to launch and tunnel casting has reached about 4 km.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 inflow outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Rs 5,500 crore won in Q1 plus Rs 1,500 crore L1 gives about Rs 7,000 crore; target is Rs 8,000-10,000 crore for FY27, with DMRC conversion expected in Q1-Q2.

qa_highlights.question: What are the margin and revenue expectations for FY27-28?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 target is 15% growth (about Rs 6,500 crore), with H2 weighted; the Rs 7,500 crore target shifted to FY28. Margins are guided at 14-15%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the working capital and debt position?
qa_highlights.answer: Working capital is 103 days, guided to 100-110. Gross debt is about Rs 840 crore after the TBM term-loan instalment. Mobilisation advance of Rs 470 crore, of which Rs 400 crore interest-bearing at about 9-10%.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a land acquisition risk in the new projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Only Vadhavan has land acquisition issues, affecting about 6-7 km of the 32 km stretch. Excavation starts in October after the monsoon.

risks_watch: Q1 margin moderation and a sharp PAT decline; management says timing and project mix drove it.
Execution slowdown from the BMC water-use restriction, which management says has been resolved, and monsoon delays on Vadhavan.
Revenue guidance is H2-weighted and depends on GMLR, Vadhavan and other new projects ramping up.
Award timing for the Rs 50,000 crore-plus pipeline may slip 3-6 months.
Gross debt rise to Rs 840 crore and higher financing cost of about 9-10%.
Land acquisition and tree-cutting permissions on Vadhavan and GMLR.
summary.management_tone: Confident on order inflow and FY27 growth, but cautious on near-term margins and execution timing. Management was evasive on specific pipeline award timing and some numbers were unclear in the transcript.
key_quotes: So overall by the year end 15% plus is very much achievable.
We'll be doing 14 to 15% of the beta margin.
So Shravan if you see like you know we don't work without margin.

adds.what: Rs 300 crore TBM for GMLR tunnel, to be capitalised within days; first TBM due to be assembled and launched shortly

growth.why: Management reiterated 15% FY27 revenue growth (~Rs 6,500 crore) and 14-15% EBITDA margin, with growth weighted to H2 as Vadhavan revenue starts in Q3; backing is a Rs 22,000 crore order book and a Rs 300 crore TBM, but the H2 ramp has no dated capacity, and Q1 revenue grew only 2% while EBITDA and PAT fell sharply.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guides FY27 EBITDA margin at 14-15% and aims toward 15-16% over time, but Q1 margin moderated to 14.1% and EBITDA and PAT fell sharply YoY (Q1 FY26 EBITDA Rs 217 crore, PAT Rs 103 crore vs ~Rs 27 crore).

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Rs 300 crore GMLR TBM to be capitalised within days and Vadhavan port road revenue starts from Q3 FY27 after October excavation start, though the H2 ramp has no dated capacity beyond these.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth of 15% (~Rs 6,500 crore) is guided and H2-weighted, but Q1 revenue grew only 2% YoY to Rs 1,511 crore and Q2 growth is only guided positive.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex guided at about Rs 150 crore a year in FY27-28 including maintenance, with no new large capex unless a big project is won; utilisation not disclosed, fund-based limits only 39% used.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management reiterated rather than raised FY27 15% growth and 14-15% margin, while Q1 revenue grew 2% and award timing may slip 3-6 months.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: FY27 15% growth depends on H2 ramp at GMLR and Vadhavan, Q1 growth was 2%, monsoon and BMC water-ban delays are cited, and the Rs 7,500 crore revenue target has already slipped to FY28.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new products, brands or models discussed.

rows.label: FY27 order inflow Rs 8,000-10,000 crore
rows.why: Rs 7,000 crore secured (Rs 5,500 crore booked plus Rs 1,500 crore DMRC underground L1) against Rs 8,000-10,000 crore target, but management warns award timing may slip 3-6 months and pipeline of Rs 50,000 crore-plus may come next year.

rows.label: Gross debt below Rs 800 crore by year-end
rows.why: Gross debt rose to Rs 840 crore from about Rs 580 crore in March on TBM term loan, guided below Rs 800 crore by year-end as term loans are repaid, with net cash at Rs -45 crore.

rows.label: Working capital held at 100-110 days
rows.why: Working capital at 103 days versus 99 days earlier, guided to stay in 100-110 day range; receivables described as prompt from major clients.

tone.note: Management was confident on FY27 15% growth, order inflow and the Chennai and GMLR timelines, but cautious on near-term margins, H2-weighted execution and award timing; the Q&A focused on margin and revenue expectations and inflow visibility.
